questions.question: Label the main advantage of HbA1c testing.
questions.solution_html:
• Label the main advantage of HbA1c testing.
  • ANS
  •  Reflects long-term glycemic control (past 2–3 months).
  •  No fasting required; can be done anytime.
  •  Not affected by short-term glucose fluctuations.
  •  Good predictor of diabetic complications.
  •  Standardized and reliable for diagnosis and monitoring. (any 3 points)
questions.final_answer:  Standardized and reliable for diagnosis and monitoring. (any 3 points)

questions.question: Analyse the reason why serum creatinine is considered a reliable indicator of / GFR.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse the reason why serum creatinine is considered a reliable indicator of GFR
  • ANS
  •  Creatinine is produced at a constant rate from muscle metabolism (breakdown of
  • creatine phosphate).
  •  This steady production makes it a stable marker under normal physiological
  • conditions.
  •  Creatinine is freely filtered through the glomerular membrane without restriction.
  •  The concentration serum creatinine increases with decrease in GFR.
  •  Even a small decrease in GFR causes a significant rise in serum creatinine.
  • (any 3 point -(3 marks))
